events.title: Demo Update 0.3.3 : Better Joining Process for Multiplayer Lobbies
events.summary: pushed an update to demo to hopefully help users trying to join multiplayer games. basically you get better visibility on joining multiplayer games. Game doesn’t freeze and you get some text about what’s going on while you are trying to join. It times out after 30s so you don’t get stuck. This won’t actually make joining faster but it does let the player know that the game is trying to join instead of just freezing up.
